dragonball.fala: Ho ho! Want to learn the Kamehameha? First you carry this shell on your back and deliver the milk. No flying, huh!
passos: Get the shell and the milk from Master Roshi
Take the milk to the spot, no flying
Bring the old man down to half his life
passos2: Get the milk from Master Roshi
Take the milk to the spot
dragonball.mais: No flying! The shell is heavy, so go slow. Come back before time runs out and then we train for real: bring me down to half my life.

dragonball.fala: Bring me some parts and I'll build you a Hoi-Poi Capsule. Just throw it on the ground and done: a whole house!
dragonball.mais: Iron for the casing and redstone for the circuits. One a day, I need to sleep too!

dragonball.fala: You want to fly? Dad taught me: you just gather your ki under your feet. But you need to be at least Tier 9!
dragonball.mais: Gather the ki under your feet and push. Double tap jump and that's it! But only from Tier 9.

dragonball.fala: You climbed all the way up without flying? Then you've earned the Sacred Water. And take a Senzu, there's one a day up here.
passos: Climb the tower without flying (161 blocks)
dragonball.mais: There are 161 blocks of tower down there. No flying, just climbing. Whoever makes it up here deserves it.

dragonball.fala: The ship's gravity machine still works. Last 120 seconds at 50x and your body comes out stronger.
Three waves of Cell Jr. in the ring. Fall off the ring and you lose.
The pod's scouter is beeping... three Saibamen come out of the ground when you get close.
dragonball.dica: They say a small ship fell in a dirt field...

dragonball.fala: Pui Pui, Yakon and Dabura guard the ship. Beat all three and Babidi offers you the Majin Mark.
Buu wants candy! Give Buu candy and Buu gives a present!
rec: Any rare item from any universe
dragonball.mais: Buu likes cake, cookies, pie and honey! Buu doesn't like people who bring no candy.

dragonball.fala: Come closer... I see a great power asleep inside you.
dragonball.dica: On Namek, a house on top of a rock...

dragonball.fala: Frieza's soldiers are coming for the dragon balls! Help us!
dragonball.dica: On Namek, round houses near the water...

naruto.fala: Take a bell from the stump in the middle of the field and keep it with you for 60 s. A few rogue ninjas will try to take it from you.
passos: Take a bell from the middle stump
Keep the bell for 60 s inside the field
naruto.mais: The timer only runs while the bell is in your inventory and you are inside the field. If a ninja hits you the bell can drop: pick it back up. Two bells = double reward.

naruto.fala: Take the Heaven and Earth scrolls from the Sound ninjas and open both at the altar.
Pull the sword from the grave and the mist closes in. Three waves of swordsmen.
Take the paper flower from the statue's tongue and get down with it in 90 s.
passos: Get down and out in 90 s
naruto.dica: They say it never stops raining in a village of towers...

naruto.fala: At sunset, touch a seal on top of a statue: Senju or Uchiha.
Climb the needle and beat the warrior toad at the top.
naruto.dica: Talking toads guard a mountain full of needles...
